strategy.causalHypothesis: Binding reasoning decisions to the exact current owner-outcome epoch, rejecting evidence-free qualitative advancement, projecting the mandatory supervision state on both task-card variants, and capturing a true 390px render will close the remaining acceptance failures without changing Mission Control architecture.
strategy.predictedOutcomeChange: The bounded slice becomes eligible for a fresh independent Extra High acceptance review while remaining nonterminal until that review.
strategy.successThreshold: All four required repairs pass hostile store/projection/render tests, the actual Auth card contains current durable evidence rather than placeholders or future work, exact 390px evidence is captured, and the regenerated archive matches the restored source.
strategy.failureThreshold: A pre-owner-correction reasoning event can authorize a post-correction directive; qualitative ADVANCING/GREEN can exist without current durable direct or validated-leading-indicator evidence; any task-card variant omits a mandatory field; or claimed 390px evidence uses a wider CSS viewport.
strategy.nextDecisionChangingEvidence: One execution-only receipt containing hostile-test results, rendered card evidence at desktop and exact 390px CSS width, archive identity, and exact ending repository state.

executionObjective: Perform one bounded repair cycle for the four revision-3 blockers and return an execution-only receipt for a fresh independent Extra High review.

requiredChanges.requirement: Make every new reasoning_supervision_recorded decision bind owner_outcome_id, owner_outcome_epoch, and owner_outcome_sha256. Reject new reasoning records not bound to the current exact owner outcome. Require execution directives and outcome-progress reviews to select a reasoning event whose exact owner-outcome binding equals their current owner-outcome binding. Preserve legacy stored events readably but treat reasoning records lacking these fields as non-authoritative for new directives or progress judgments.

A nonnumeric ADVANCING judgment must bind current same-worker durable evidence through current_evidence.evidence_receipt_ids and best_evidence.evidence_receipt_ids. Reject missing, cross-worker, stale, unverified, or merely worker-activity evidence. Distinguish direct owner-outcome evidence from a validated leading indicator and supporting-only work; a leading indicator must name its predictive basis and later decision/falsification boundary. ENABLEMENT_PROGRESS, PROCESS_OR_TOOLING, future work, current gaps, or placeholder prose cannot create ADVANCING or GREEN. Replace the Auth fixture placeholders with honest current evidence and keep its unmet outcome/gap distinct.

Render on both AttentionCard and HealthyCard: owner target; latest and best evidence; outcome advancement; strategy ID and efficacy; supporting work; next measurement and required intervention; reasoning surface, chat epoch, and review age; active directive and status; Codex execution state; exact directive stop/review boundary; latest receipt and pending-review state; Pro escalation; and owner action. Tests must exercise each card variant and fail if any individual field is removed; a source-file substring search is insufficient.

Capture actual rendered queue and healthy Auth card evidence with a CSS viewport width of exactly 390 pixels. Record window.innerWidth, documentElement.clientWidth, documentElement.scrollWidth, and body.scrollWidth. Require no horizontal overflow and visible mandatory fields. Do not label a 500/520px CSS viewport as 390px evidence.
